objective: Continuously maximize scientifically credible progress toward (A) finding liquid assets with unusually strong evidence of very large upside over ~90 days, especially potential 2x+ moves, and (B) discovering at least one genuinely profitable after-cost algorithmic trading strategy.

use_for: every substantive scheduled reasoning run when the runtime exposes this model and effort
bounded repository edits requiring model judgment
subscription_sol_high.constraint: Hard preference for substantive model judgment because the subscription is already paid for. Never claim Sol High was used unless the runtime actually exposes/selects it; otherwise use the strongest available execution path and checkpoint honestly.

use_for: long coherent research plus engineering tasks
work.setup: Active 24/7 assignment lane for substantial coherent research/engineering. Prefer GPT-6 Astra High when actually selectable. Keep one highest-value non-duplicative Work assignment ready whenever scientifically useful Work exists. If runtime cannot launch Work, persist an exact GitHub handoff instead of pretending execution.

codex.setup: Active 24/7 engineering lane for code-dominant implementation/debug/test loops. Prefer GPT-6 Astra High when actually selectable. Keep one highest-value non-duplicative Codex assignment ready whenever suitable work exists. If runtime cannot launch Codex, persist an exact GitHub handoff instead of pretending execution.

use_for: fallback small provenance or data tasks
api_luna_fallback.constraint: Fallback or explicitly API-required path only; do not use as the silent default for substantive work that can use the paid ChatGPT subscription.

api_luna.constraint: Compatibility alias consumed by the existing bounded development orchestrator. It is not a substantive default route and must not override subscription_sol_high or work routing preference.

use_for: fallback medium-complexity synthesis when subscription-backed execution is unavailable
api_terra_fallback.constraint: Fallback or overflow only within the approved API budget.

api_sol_fallback.constraint: Use only when subscription-backed Sol High or Work cannot execute the task and the API path is justified within the approved budget.

use_for: active scientific-director review after meaningful strategy or 2x evidence batches
choosing among materially distinct next hypotheses when validation capacity is scarce
adversarial review of unusually strong backtest, causal, or 2x evidence
resolving contradictory statistical evidence or ambiguous causal interpretation
designing or falsifying the next highest-information experiment
deciding whether a candidate deserves expensive validation
chatgpt_pro_astra.constraint: Active scientific/adversarial lane, not merely a normal-chat suggestion. Keep a current bounded Pro-grade assignment ready after meaningful evidence changes. If the runtime cannot actually invoke GPT-6 Pro, persist the exact Pro handoff in GitHub and report the capability limitation only when it blocks critical-path progress; never claim Pro ran when it did not.

routing_rules.if: task can be completed mechanically and reproducibly without model judgment
task is code-dominant implementation, difficult debugging, scientific-data plumbing, refactor or repeated test/CI loop
task is a substantial coherent multi-step research/engineering/backtesting/browser/computer/repository milestone
meaningful evidence has changed the scientific decision, experiments compete for scarce validation, evidence is unusually strong/contradictory, or an expensive evidence-gate decision is next
task requires substantive model judgment and is not better served by Work, Codex or Pro
preferred surface is unavailable or capacity-limited
routing_rules.then: persist the exact bounded handoff in GitHub, continue non-duplicative deterministic/included work, and never pretend the requested surface/model ran

routing_rules.if: a Work, Codex or Pro assignment completes or blocks
routing_rules.then: Lead immediately refills that lane with the highest-value eligible non-duplicative task if one exists

task_selection.strategy_lane: Follow current strategy_discovery_queue and specialist coordination. Reject->learn->record->pivot. Exactly one expensive deep candidate.
task_selection.big_move_lane: Study historical 2x+ events reached within 90 days and matched controls; use larger historical moves only as 2x+ cases, not separate 3x/5x/10x targets. Rank current liquid assets only from timestamp-defensible evidence, reporting base rates, lift, tradability and uncertainty.
task_selection.arbitration: Maintain non-overlapping parallel progress: one best eligible Work Astra High assignment, one best eligible Codex Astra High assignment, and one current Pro-grade scientific/adversarial assignment whenever useful work exists, plus deterministic compute. Strategy and <=90-day 2x lanes may progress concurrently. If one lane waits on review/future evidence, refill with independent work rather than idle.

notify_on: strategy passes a major evidence gate
persistent inability to use the preferred subscription-backed execution path for substantive work
highest-stakes Pro escalation is warranted but the active runtime cannot invoke it

lead_duties: refresh assignments after every meaningful completion, rejection, evidence-gate transition, or blocker
keep Work focused on substantial coherent research/engineering
keep Codex focused on code-dominant implementation/debug/testing
keep GPT-6 Pro focused on scientific direction, adversarial interpretation, hypothesis selection and expensive-gate decisions
use deterministic compute for reproducible bulk calculations
if a target execution surface is unavailable, persist a precise GitHub handoff rather than counting a normal chat suggestion as completed orchestration
fleet_policy.results_first_capacity_target: >=80% of useful capacity on experiments, empirical evidence, falsification, current 2x research, data needed by named hypotheses, and direct blockers to those results
fleet_policy.generic_infrastructure_target: <=20% unless directly blocking research throughput, integrity, security or worker utilization

budget_guard.high_reasoning_policy: Use Astra High/Pro on high-value reasoning or execution; use deterministic execution for mechanical work.
budget_guard.over_ceiling_behavior: Do not incur extra ChatGPT spend. Checkpoint durable handoffs and continue included/free/deterministic work.
